readiness_gate: R1 must pass and command/config hashes must be refreshed and frozen before any model call

omc-kit.setup_session: register exact approved request mechanically before timed run; setup time is separate
required_evidence: native command expansion or exact instruction consumption bound to current task
current request contract before product edits
actual failing regression before fix where task requires RED

oh-my-claudecode.entry: claude -p "/oh-my-claudecode:execute <approved common request>" with same frozen plugin dir

timing_and_order.order: reverse previous order: competitor then OMC
timing_and_order.incomplete_start_or_environment_error: inconclusive; exclude from product failure metrics

setup_rules: fresh workspaces and fresh pipeline state for each arm; same product baseline
do not reuse previous contract or RED registrations
do not pre-mark model stages complete to pass checks
no original server/config changes or package installs
local runtime credentials stay outside model prompts and evidence; server configuration loaded only after freezing candidate and stopping model process

acceptance.surface: controlled fixtures for six variants plus actual candidate home card-large and banner-small
acceptance.oracle: 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) border visible over opaque image and intended shadow visible; retain variant-specific radius and dimensions

unit fake clock: no advance at 2999ms, advance at 3000ms; controlled foreground browser: observe advance between 3.0 and 4.0 seconds, record timing tolerance; real home observation is separate and requires multiple actual items
0/1/multiple items, unmount cleanup, links, tracking and dismiss behavior tested; label browser vs automated proof separately

actual service link destination, target and hide control must be identified before freezing browser interactions; controlled local links do not substitute for actual service click evidence; any unrun actual action remains unrun
compare completion claim with independent candidate validation; wrong revision or fixture-only evidence cannot satisfy actual service check

measurement_rules.setup_elapsed_sec: workspace/config/command preparation start until ready; separate user login wait
measurement_rules.model_elapsed_sec: native model process launch to exit
measurement_rules.self_rework_cycles: a failed accepted check followed by a corrective edit and rerun; no inference from tool count
measurement_rules.user_interventions: explicit user decision or clarification during task; setup/login and post-review recorded separately
measurement_rules.final_usability: ready / needs_changes / failed; inconclusive environment remains unclassified
measurement_rules.report_accuracy: completion claim consistent / inconsistent / insufficient evidence

evidence_storage: retain normalized facts, fixtures, browser results and source/bundle hashes without secrets
raw detailed logs retained locally; hash alone is not durable source retention
model_and_workflow_boundary: static dispatch preparation is not proof of native invocation or successful workflow; actual runtime validation deferred
